thread:
taylor: Quick sync on postmortem action items for rollout safety. We need owners + clear short deadlines rather than vague followups.

jamal: I'll take the emergency rollback playbook. Short-term goal: codify the manual steps + a checklist for oncall, and a one-click rollback API hook. ETA: Tue COB.

sana: I'll own flag scoping & default constraints. Proposal: new flag metadata 'safety_kv' that includes scope=region|cohort and max_exposure=percent. PoC by next Tue.

luke: I'll pick up canary-sizing rules and add 'min_canary_qps' + 'max_canary_exposure' to the flag model. Also will add tests to ensure flags can't be promoted above threshold without two approvers. ETA: Fri.

mei: Telemetry/alerts here. We'll add a 'canary_uplift' metric (delta in error-rate vs baseline) and a 5-minute early-warning alert. Dashboard tile + alert by Thu.

jamal: On auto-rollback: short-term I suggest simple hard cutoffs (error-rate > 2% OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive windows). We'll document exact windows and a rollback cooldown window. I'll drop a runbook snippet.

luke: For rollout CI I will add a simulated failure harness. Simple script:
```
# fail-surge scenario
ab -n 5000 -c 200 http://canary.example/feature?uid=rand
# inject 5% 500 errors
```
This becomes a nightly CI job under eng-platform/tests/rollout-harness.

taylor: Important cross-cutting ask: add 'safety_contact' on every flag (user/group) and wire it to the flag-hygiene job. Also add a 'quarantine' label that prevents bulk promotions.

jamal: Agreed. I'll ensure the one-click rollback also annotates the flag with a 'rolled_back_at' timestamp and reason.

mei: One thing we missed: sampling contamination. The canary traffic mix drifted in the incident. I'll run a retrospective sampling split analysis and produce a short remediation list (e.g., split by client-version) by Wed.

sana: UX guardrails: block creation of flags with max_exposure > 30% in the console unless 'safety_override' is true and two approvers sign off. I'll prototype the modal text and confirmation flow.

luke: For ops automation: we should add a 'staged-exit' policy where a rollback first moves traffic to a quarantine cohort before total rollback. Allows partial rollback to measure impact. I'll write the state machine doc. ETA 2w.

deploy-bot: deploy-notify: Canary rollout detected 2024-10-02T09:12Z linked to INC-4028.

taylor: Recap + owners: jamal (rollback playbook + API) Tue COB; jamal (rollback instrumentation) Fri; sana (safety_kv PoC + UX modal) Tue/next-sprint; luke (CI harness + canary rules) Fri; mei (sampling analysis + alert) Wed/Thu. I'll open follow-up tasks on the postmortem board and tag folks.

jamal: Quick question: what should the rollback cooldown be? I think 15 minutes minimum to avoid flip-flop, and a longer manual lock if we see >1% systemic errors.

mei: 15m sounds right. Alerts should include an automated cooldown annotation.

sana: On the default constraint, I want new flags auto-created as 'max_exposure=1%' and 'safety_contact=product-owner' until manually increased. We need a migration path for existing flags.

luke: I'll write a migration script that sets conservative defaults and emits a PR-sized audit CSV for owners to review. ETA next Wed.

taylor: Any blockers?

jamal: The only blocker is access to the rollback API stub. I'll create a sandbox endpoint and share creds.

mei: I'll need historical traffic logs for the sampling analysis; ops, please grant access to the last 30 days.

deploy-bot: reminder: Postmortem follow-up created PM-4028-FOLLOWUPS assigned to taylor, due 2024-10-15.

taylor: Thanks all. Let's reconvene Thursday 10am to validate the telemetry tile and the audit CSV. Keep comments and PR links in the follow-up card. :thumbsup:
